name: compaction_handoff
description: Keeps a long-lived Claude Code session's work across context compaction. From a configured share of the expected compaction point, each turn start asks the agent to write a handoff to L2 with context_save (in progress, next step, open items), recognised by a name prefix and the session id in its frontmatter. Before every compaction a fallback record with figures only (no conversation text) is written to L2, and one auto-compaction per cycle is held off when no fresh handoff exists; manual compactions are never held off. After a compaction the session is always told which handoff and fallback to read, or that none was found or could be determined. Claude Code formats live in hooks/; L2 is read and written through KairosChain's own context interface. Design: log/compaction_handoff_design_v0.3.md (KairosChain repository).
author: Masaomi Hatakeyama
